content.text: At 5 months Theo is just about there -- Health Canada puts the window at around 6 months, so you've got roughly 4 weeks before you start watching for the signs: sitting with minimal support, losing the tongue-thrust reflex, and showing interest in food. Iron-rich first foods (pureed meat, fortified cereal) are the recommended starting point, confirmed with his provider at the 6-month well-baby visit.
